about.title: Looking for the right repair?
paragraphs: Have you been looking for affordable repair and for certified mechanics that will perform your repair just right? E & B Motors specializes in many different repairs, and we will gladly help you get what you need.
From timing belts, maintenance and A/C to engine repair, tires, breakdowns and battery changes, we service all makes and models, plus motorcycles.
Please contact us to schedule an appointment, or feel free to visit us for a free diagnosis. Se habla español.

estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and we will get back to you. Or call (503) 489-5088, Monday to Friday 8am to 6pm and Saturday 8am to 5pm.

services.name: Vehicle Maintenance
services.blurb: Oil changes, filters, belts, hoses and more.
services.intro: Proper vehicle maintenance will help you keep your car in good standing, avoid potentially costly breakdowns and extend the life of your car.
includes: Cabin, engine air and fuel filters
photos: Pouring fresh oil into an engine

services.name: Brakes
services.blurb: Inspections, pads, rotors, drums and lines.
services.intro: From a brake inspection to new pads, rotors and lines, we keep your stopping power where it should be.
photos: Front suspension and brakes on a classic car

services.name: Tires
services.intro: E & B Motors can do tire repair and also replacements. We will check your tire life and performance to let you know if it is a good option just to repair the current tire or replace it with a new one.
photos: Mechanic tightening lug nuts on a wheel

services.name: Engine Repairs
services.blurb: Repair or rebuild before you replace the car.
services.intro: When a car or truck needs major engine repair, the first reaction of many people is to buy a new or used vehicle. Often that's simply not necessary. If your vehicle is in relatively good shape, it makes sense to update it by rebuilding or replacing the engine rather than replacing the vehicle.
photos: Camshafts and engine parts laid out during an engine repair
Blue Camaro with the hood up in the shop
Jeep Wrangler with the hood up

services.name: Mufflers & Exhaust
services.intro: Holes and rust are the most common muffler damage, and rain, snow, ice, salted roads and rough road conditions all take their toll. The right muffler depends on the vehicle you own, and we'll help you find it.
photos: Suspension and exhaust under a raised car

services.name: Motorcycle Services
services.intro: A full motorcycle service irons out mechanical or electrical problems before they affect the safe operation of your bike. Your motorcycle may also be more efficient and more pleasant to ride when all the components are in optimum condition.
